finding.claim: _executeSubCommand adds 5 process signal forwarders on every call and never removes them, so a second execution double-counts signals and leaks listeners.
finding.title: Signal listeners accumulate on repeated subcommand execution

verifier.reason: The code at command.js:1291-1301 registers process.on handlers for five signals on every _executeSubCommand call, and the close/error handlers at command.js:1306-1343 contain no process.removeListener/off cleanup, so repeated executions accumulate listeners.
